description: Takes one pitch and gives the twelve semitones above it, one to a jack

inputs.text: The pitch every output is measured from, at 1V per octave

outputs.text: The input a minor second higher
The input a major second higher
The input a minor third higher
The input a major third higher
The input a fourth higher, five semitones
The input a fifth higher, seven semitones
The input a minor sixth higher
The input a major sixth higher
The input a minor seventh higher
The input a major seventh higher

notes: there is no output for the input itself; take the pitch from wherever it came for that.
with nothing patched the input reads 0V, so the outputs carry the twelve semitones above C4.

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
